# Practice log

Short entries after each session, newest first.

Thursday: Bach prelude, left hand alone, slow. The fingering in bar nine finally works. Half an hour.

Tuesday: Schubert impromptu, the middle section with the triplets. Too fast again; reduced the tempo and played it clean three times. Forty minutes.

Sunday: only scales, no energy. Twenty minutes and an early night.

Saturday: played the Satie pieces for a neighbour who came by. Pleasant, not perfect.
